task: In Production, turn on the flag "loyalty_points" for the "power_users" segment only, serving the value "eu_west". Everyone else in Production keeps the current setting, and Development is not changed.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `loyalty_points` now has a segment override for `power_users` (id 23) that is enabled and serves `eu_west`. The environment default stays off with value `off_copy`, so everyone else is unchanged, and Development has no override and is unchanged.
